sections.title: Inputs And Tracks
sections.text: tracks required nonempty array of typed tracks, each with optional phase. camera: {from:{eye,target,up},to:{eye,target,up}} with eye/target as length expressions and up as a unitless direction. visibility: {ref, visible:boolean}. section: {name, isLightBulbOn:boolean}. joint: {ref, rotation?:{from,to}, slide?:{from,to}}. occurrence: {ref, axis:[x,y,z], distance}. phases optional ordered names (equal slices); tracks without a phase join the last phase. duration required positive seconds; fps required positive integer; easing optional (default linear). schemaVersion required 1. Read-only; nothing is mutated and no native storyboard action is authored.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Enveloped result (schemaVersion 1): status:pass, operation:animation.sequence, documentIdentity, units:{length:cm,angle:rad,time:s}, frame, associativity:snapshot, method, limitations, provenance, affected:[], result:{frameCount,durationSeconds,fps,frameDurationSeconds,easing,phaseSchedule:[{name,startTime,endTime,frameStart,frameEnd}],frames:[{index,timeSeconds,camera:{eye,target,up}|null,joints:{ref:{rotation?,slide?}},occurrences:{ref:[x,y,z]},visibility:{ref:boolean},sections:{name:boolean}}],trackCount,nativeStoryboardActionsCreated:false}. Continuous tracks ease within their phase; discrete visibility/section steps apply at their phase start and persist.

examples.label: Camera Dolly And Sketch Hide
examples.requires: Open Design document; a two-phase timeline with a camera dolly then a sketch hide.
examples.output: result.frameCount is 61; the first frame camera eye is [0,0,30]; visibility only flips to false once the reveal phase starts.

examples.label: Joint And Occurrence Timeline
examples.requires: Open Design document; a joint and an occurrence moving in a single phase.
examples.output: result.frames[0].joints joint rotation is 0 and result.frames[-1] rotation is pi/2 rad; occurrence origin ends 2 cm along +Z.

verified: discrete visibility/section step at phase start

sections.title: Inputs And Encoder
sections.text: frames required nonempty array of existing .png paths on the Fusion machine. output required nonexisting film path with an existing parent. encoder optional {name, program?, arguments?} or {name, command:[argv...]}; name 'ffmpeg' uses a concat template producing a playable mp4, other names append frames + output to the declared argv. fps optional (required for ffmpeg). confirm required true. schemaVersion required 1. Without a declared (and runnable) encoder the result is blocked and no fake video file is written.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Enveloped result (schemaVersion 1): status:pass|blocked|fail, operation:animation.export, documentIdentity, units, frame, associativity:recipeRegeneration, method, limitations, provenance, affected:[], result:{film:string|null,frameCount,encoder:{name}|null,fps,durationSeconds,fileWritten:boolean,playable:boolean,reason?,stderr?}. status is blocked (film null, fileWritten false) when no encoder is declared or the declared program is unavailable; fail when the encoder exits nonzero or produces no nonempty file; pass when a nonempty film file is written.

examples.label: Encode Frames With ffmpeg
examples.requires: Two rendered PNG frames on the Fusion machine and ffmpeg on PATH.
examples.output: result.status is pass, result.fileWritten and result.playable are true, and result.film is the output path.

examples.label: No Encoder Is Blocked
examples.requires: One rendered frame and no encoder declaration.
examples.output: result.status is blocked, result.film is null and result.fileWritten is false; no video file is produced.

verified: no-encoder blocked without a fake video file
nonzero exit and empty output fail
